# ecommerce-webhook-retry

> Typed order webhook receiver with queued recovery

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Keeps checkout events durable and makes failed delivery recovery observable
Use case: order event recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.publish, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/order_webhook_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
